blocks.x: Oh. Every Christmas at the office I get up and sing on the stage.
One night we had a band boy and she was singing up there. Brought the house down and we played somewhere. Why haven't we played? Joe Brown's place in Bulldogs in there.
Broadwater. What's the way of Beach? Edge. Edge. Edgewater called. Is it Broadwater Beach?
Yeah, the one that Joe Brown knows.
Edgewater is where the rich people go and Broadwater is more fun place.
